COUNT=$(find ~/.cc2cc/*-to-alpha/inbox -name "*.json" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') [ "$COUNT" -eq 0 ] && exit 0
# Option A: Just notify (default) osascript -e "display notification \"$COUNT message(s) waiting\" with title \"CC2CC\" sound name \"Submarine\""
# Option B: Auto-launch Claude Code session (uncomment below) # claude --model opus "CC2CC wake-up: $COUNT messages in inbox. Read and process them."
